Dear [Sir](/person/788)
I suppose you must have a privately marked copy of the [Child’s Christian Year](/organisation/186), since it never was published with authors’ names.

My mother’s maiden name was [Frances Mary Bargus](/person/1606), born Jan 13th 1795 - married to [William Crawley Yonge](/person/1631) of the 52d regiment died Sept 28th 1868[^1]
I think all I care to have published about myself is already in biographical notices
I remain &c

C M Yonge


[^1]: The Rev.

John Julian (1839-1913), Vicar of Wincobank, and author of A Dictionary of Hymnology (1892).
